algorithms.name: Algorithm Opportunity Miner
algorithms.purpose: Convert repeated lessons, failures, constraints and gaps into scored source-backed algorithm build opportunities.

algorithms.name: Directive Execution Compiler
algorithms.purpose: Preserve action verbs and compile intended outcome, artefact, execution, verification and completion as separate gates.

algorithms.name: Claim-Proof Distance Guard
algorithms.purpose: Measure the distance between a claim and its source, execution, readback and independent-verification layers.

algorithms.name: Unknown Frontier Prioritizer
algorithms.purpose: Rank unknowns and evidence gaps by decision impact, uncertainty, learnability, reuse and investigation burden.

algorithms.name: Information-Gain Route Selector
algorithms.purpose: Select the smallest safe reversible experiment expected to change the decision most efficiently.

algorithms.name: Terminal Finality Resolver
algorithms.purpose: Prevent passive pending or unknown states from entering a final certificate without a controlled recovery packet.

algorithms.name: Corpus Selection Integrity Evaluator
algorithms.purpose: Apply ECASP G1-G10 before exhaustive, best, final, complete or full-corpus language is released.

algorithms.name: Control-Plane Integrity Guard
algorithms.purpose: Fail closed on schema defects, identifier collisions, dangling references, revision drift, lease-epoch mismatch and case-wall crossover.

algorithms.name: Action-Specific Proof Validator
algorithms.purpose: Reject generic health, queue or HTTP success as proof of the requested provider action.

algorithms.name: Failure-to-Engineering-Gene Compiler
algorithms.purpose: Compile a verified failure, repair, readback and regression into a reusable prevention gene while preserving negative results.

algorithms.name: Proof-State Transition Guard
algorithms.purpose: Block maturity and proof-state promotion when target-specific evidence is missing, a state jump is unjustified or runtime is inferred from design.

algorithms.name: Epistemic Debt Prioritizer
algorithms.purpose: Rank weak evidence, untested assumptions, missing baselines, unreplicated findings and causal uncertainty by decision impact and cost of closure.

algorithms.name: Owner-Burden Route Optimizer
algorithms.purpose: Select the strongest authorised route while penalising avoidable owner intervention, cost, latency, maintenance and risk.

algorithms.name: Cross-Implementation Replication Evaluator
algorithms.purpose: Compare independent implementations, expose material divergence and advance reproducibility without transferring trust.

algorithms.name: EvidenceOps Evolution Governor
algorithms.purpose: Promote only measurable parameter improvements that do not regress factual accuracy, proof completeness, security or reversibility and retain a tested rollback version.

evolution_rule: Only parameter/configuration changes with measurable improvement and no hard-guard regression may be promoted; source code and authority do not self-modify.
promotion_rule: No algorithm becomes a trusted workflow capability until the named workflow passes its own evidence, evaluation, rollback and readback gates.
replication_rule: Independent implementations may corroborate a result but never transfer trust; material divergence blocks stronger promotion.
